investigation_notes.Description: A PowerShell script was executed on the host SRV-APP-03 by user a.petrov that downloads a binary from an external host and executes it in memory via IEX. The script block references http://185.199.88.22/update.bin, indicating an external payload fetch and immediate execution. While IP reputation shows no abuse signals for 185.199.88.22, the combination of external payload delivery and in-memory execution is a high-risk behavior warranting HP classification and prompt investigation.
